change.origin: Soak 37153082817 on master f93b72699 stopped at the disk hygiene band with 8,047 MB free. The failure-evidence copy duplicated every earlier harness session into each failed iteration. The copies were 13.6 GB of the 15 GB output.
driver: The failure-evidence copy takes only files newer than the iteration's .started marker, like every other reader of the harness roots.
reset_harness_archives clears the harness data and log-archive roots after each completed iteration, the same reset the workflow applies after the preflight.
change.test: Scenario 4 runs two failed iterations. The second iteration's evidence and the harness root must not keep the first session.
change.unchanged: Disk admission, the guardian, the hygiene band, the breach channels, the state file, and the summary contract are unchanged.

related_claims.CLAIM-SOAK-001: proposed-unratified. The driver and its test are artifacts of docs/claims/soak-disk-protection.md. Its disk admission and guardian behavior are unchanged.

driver_suite_local.environment: Linux container with the casper-soak harness binary built from the same tree

regression_control.description: The new test with the driver from 1a1baa924
regression_control.result: Iteration 2 evidence kept session 1, as the bug predicts.

verification.evidence_before_cleanup: Every reader of the harness roots runs before the reset: iteration metrics, the failure-evidence copy, and the breach marker search. A breach ends the loop before the reset, so its evidence stays in place.

hosted.note: e8e084fef adds only a docs/ToDos.md entry to the change commit 602d63c7b, so the tested driver and test bytes equal the source digests.

expected_gate_state: check-casper-claims passes because docs/claims/casper-soak-harness.md has status pending. The two ledger records stay at the 2026-09-19 digests until the maintainer accepts this package.
